context: A barista chats with an aunt about her recent overseas visit
purpose: Teach: 宿泊/入場/新幹線/来日/訪れる/治安/地帯/豪華

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 直子さん、お久しぶりです！海外旅行はどうでしたか？今日もいつものラテで大丈夫ですか？
lines.en: Naoko-san, long time no see! How was your overseas trip? The usual latte today?
lines.style: Warm, welcoming barista tone with familiar customer rapport.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええ、お願い。北欧を回ってきたのよ。どこも治安がよくて、夜でも安心して歩けたわ。
lines.en: Yes, please. I toured Northern Europe. Everywhere felt safe, I could walk at night without worry.
lines.style: Relaxed mature aunt sharing travel memories with warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、いいですね。宿泊はホテルですか？それとも民泊みたいなところ？
lines.en: Oh, that's nice. Did you stay at hotels? Or somewhere like a guesthouse?
lines.style: Genuinely curious young barista asking follow-up questions casually.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 後半は豪華なホテルに泊まったの。一泊だけね。お城を改装した宿で、入場するだけで気持ちが上がっちゃって。
lines.en: For the latter half I stayed at a luxurious hotel. Just one night. It was a converted castle, and just entering lifted my spirits.
lines.style: Mature woman recounting indulgent moments with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわあ、お城ですか！僕も一度はそういうところに泊まってみたいなあ。観光客がたくさん訪れる場所なんですよね？
lines.en: Wow, a castle! I'd love to stay somewhere like that someday. It must be a place lots of tourists visit, right?
lines.style: Wide-eyed young man expressing envy with friendly enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そうそう、人気の観光地帯だから予約が大変だったわ。来日する友達にもぜひ勧めたいくらい。
lines.en: That's right, it's a popular tourist area so booking was tough. I'd love to recommend it to friends who come visit Japan too.
lines.style: Travel-savvy aunt giving practical recommendations with affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あ、移動は何で？ヨーロッパにも新幹線みたいな高速鉄道があるんですよね？
lines.en: Oh, how did you get around? Europe has high-speed rail like the Shinkansen too, right?
lines.style: Curious barista keeping conversation flowing during quiet shift.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええ、すごく便利だったわよ。次は甥っ子も連れて行こうかしら。あ、ラテもう一杯もらえる？
lines.en: Yes, it was really convenient. Maybe next time I'll bring my nephew along. Oh, can I get another latte?
lines.style: Aunt wrapping up story warmly before placing another order.
